title: Apollo-era Mission Control during a critical mission phase

situation.who: Flight controllers, support engineers, supervisors, occasional VIP/media at glass, runners
situation.what: Mission operations during Apollo launch/flight phases
situation.where: Mission Control-style console room (MOCR/KSC public imagery pattern): console rows facing large front displays, side aisles, raised or rear supervisor positions, glassed visitor gallery
situation.when: Apollo era (late 1960s–early 1970s), interior artificial light, long shifts
situation.why: Operational mission support — high focus, role specialization
situation.how: Seated at consoles with headsets, standing supervisors and floaters in aisles, quiet urgency, restricted gallery behind glass
